items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: I think the second line was somewhere, he's around 900 or 1,000, behind Black Bennett.

ctx.x: But he was buried with his shoes on.

That's right. All that was requested, he wanted to be full dressed. And see, a long time ago when they used to bury people, they used to bury people with all their jewelry. They were watching everything, everything a person desired, they were buried, you see. That's why you take the section, the graveyard section, man, they have so much jewelry, you know. I know a fellow had box of stuff. All kinds of good, nice gold stuff and everything. Another thing too, I'll tell you about the broomsticks, eh? The broomstick…
All jammed together, huh? Jammed together.
